# Correct the current OpenPGP constructor and retain delegate callback ownership

This corrects the current-name claim in 575fbc8a5fdc020fafce6dc02bb955dacbc9227d019da191266a8df30385eb58. The accepted module exports class PgpMimeHandler, and components.conf names that constructor. It does not expose PgpMimeHandler.newHandler or a class named Handler. onStartRequest creates a MimeDecryptHandler for encrypted content or an EnigmailVerify verifier for signed content. It binds the data and stop callbacks to that delegate and deletes the stored callbacks after stop handling. Preserve this current constructor and per-stream delegate boundary. The older wrapper-constructor simplification remains historical evidence. Static public Git source and component registration checked; no stream runtime, build, lint, shutdown or browser review validation ran. Historical bug and review discussion remains pending.

Scope: mail / extensions.
